items.title: RTX (RTX) Stock May Be Undervalued On Its 183% Three Year Run
items.summary: RTX has ridden a powerful multi year run, yet with the stock around US$193.54 after a recent pullback, the real question is whether that price is still anchored to the cash the business can generate over time. Over the past 3 years the share price has climbed 182.9%, which puts a lot of past optimism and current expectations on the line for anyone asking what cash flows can reasonably support.
